profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland, California, that supports people affected by incarceration, including people in prison, those returning home, and their families. Founded in 1977, it offers reentry, family and community programs in the San Francisco Bay Area.

review.notes: Centerforce is an Oakland 501(c)(3) (EIN 94-2446248) serving people and families affected by incarceration, matching the agenda's Oakland location and a no-cost student and family services MOU. ProPublica, the About page and the Contact page support the name, EIN, type, address, phone, generic info@ email, founding year and summary, which is neutral; no source ties it to OUSD directly and ProPublica notes it is absent from the latest IRS list.
